name: fde-demo-builder
description: Turn a raw screen recording into a polished, VO-narrated demo video — fully scripted (ffmpeg + edge-tts + headless Chrome), no video editor. v2: word-synced animated b-roll + multi-voice narration. v3: booth-ready production films from real pixels (original screen → zoom, real scrolls and typing), narration as the clock, deterministic render, linear-loudness mastering, QA gates. v4: production craft — velocity-matched seams, camera kit, caption lane + overlays, voice carve + audio gates, scene lint + determinism canary, BRIEF/STORYBOARD review loop, blocks, media ledger + export presets, honest finishing. v5: the picture layer — GSAP timelines on the clock, kinetic typography, WebGL transitions in declared seam windows, three.js 3D titles, story blocks, light / depth / hand-drawn annotation / frosted glass, hero reveals, a redrawn cursor and camera from recorded telemetry, idle detection, an OCR privacy leak gate, karaoke captions + .ass sidecars + chapters, staging and vertical reflow, brand kits + ten skins, a live studio, an offline review pack, synthesized SFX and bus chains — all rendered on software GL so two renders are byte-identical, with product pixels never recoloured. Every video carries the mandatory 'Crafted with FDE Demo Builder · by Ahmed Awan' end-screen credit.
